name: agent-qa
description: Three skills for authoring natural-language web and mobile tests, triaging failures, and debugging fixes with MCP evidence

Both used gpt-6-sol with memory and self-improvement off; AppControlBench gives half credit for partial completion. ## See it in action **Inspect a failure.** The demo catches a cart showing $29 instead of $53, with the failed step and its screenshot side by side. **See what memory contributed.** Inspect the knowledge supplied to a run and trace it back to the steps that used it. **Run from your terminal.** Real output from the demo suite: checkout passes; the deliberate cart-total bug fails. ## Get started Requires Node.js 24+. ```sh npm install -D agent-qa npx agent-qa init ``` Follow the [quickstart](https://vostride.com/docs/agent-qa/quickstart) to connect a model and run the demo, or [set up with your coding agent](https://vostride.com/docs/agent-qa/agent-quickstart). > [!NOTE] > Early stage. Your AI QA engineer, with memory. Describe a user journey in plain language. agent-qa tests it on web, Android or iOS and keeps the evidence. Use the CLI, the dashboard, or your coding agent through MCP and skills.

  • memidex: remembers facts and working procedures as reviewable files in your repository.
  • Self-improvement: validates lessons from runs, retires stale knowledge, and uses your feedback to correct mistakes.

| Benchmark | Rank | Published result |

| --- | --- | --- |

| AndroidWorld | #1 | 100% pass@1 (116/116 tasks) |

| AppControlBench | #1 | 99.6% completion (114.5/115 points) |

Read the full benchmark reports, with run evidence and methodology, on our blog. Both used gpt-6-sol with memory and self-improvement off; AppControlBench gives half credit for partial completion.

See it in action

Inspect a failure. The demo catches a cart showing $29 instead of $53, with the failed step and its screenshot side by side.

Get started

Requires Node.js 24+.


npm install -D agent-qa

npx agent-qa init

Follow the quickstart to connect a model and run the demo, or set up with your coding agent.

> [!NOTE]

> Early stage. Expect bugs. Report an issue when something breaks.
